steps.caption: Displayed ethane: every vertex is an atom and every edge is a single bond. Count three H atoms attached to each C.
Condensed: the same two carbons remain joined. CH₃ replaces three drawn C–H bonds; no atoms have been removed.
Skeletal: a single segment represents the carbon chain. ① and ② are endpoint annotations, not atom symbols. Predict hidden H at each endpoint before stepping.
Answer: each endpoint C has one C–C bond, so each needs three C–H bonds to reach four. Ethane remains C₂H₆.
